doc_title_en: Update on management initiatives to realize capital-cost-aware and stock-price-conscious business operations
doc_title_jp: 資本コストや株価を意識した経営の実現に向けた対応について（アップデート）

key_facts.reason_jp: 資本コストや株価を意識した経営

summary_en: ROE target 8% by FY3/30 (interim 7.6% by FY3/28); PBR ≥1.0. FY3/26 ROE 6.87% vs 6% cost of equity. Dividend payout ratio 40% during mid-term plan (FY3/26-28). Growth capex prioritized; IR activity enhanced to improve market awareness.
summary_jp: ROE目標 FY3/30 8％（中期 FY3/28 7.6％）；PBR ≥1.0。FY3/26 ROE 6.87％ vs 資本コスト6％。配当性向40％（中期計画期間）。成長投資優先；IR活動強化。
